title: Refactor Dotnet Kit API to Stateful with Five Kit Kinds
description: Refactor compose/net/Compose/Compose.cs and compose/net/Compose.Tests/Tests.cs: rename KitKind values File/Folder/Temporary to Dev/Local/Transport, refactor ComposeDiff Apply*Diff methods to mutate in-place, add stateful kit kind classes, update callers/tests, and run dotnet test in compose/net.
summary:
Refactored all five language bindings from functional style to stateful in-place mutation to avoid expensive memory copies. 

**Kit kind renames across all languages:**
- `file` → `dev` (DevKit: synchronized JSON file)
- `folder` → `local` (LocalKit: synchronized folder with .compose/kit.db)
- `temporary` → `transport` (TransportKit: static JSON string)
- `archive` → `archive` (ArchiveKit: static zipped local kit)
- `remote` → `remote` (RemoteKit: synchronized websocket)

**Core change: All apply*Diff functions converted from functional (return new object) to stateful (mutate in-place, return void).**

Per language:
- **TypeScript** (compose/js/index.ts): 35 apply functions converted, all callers updated, kit classes added (TransportKit, ArchiveKit, SyncKit interface, DevKit, LocalKit, RemoteKit), InMemoryKitStore updated, sketchpad stores updated. 230/230 tests pass.
- **Python** (compose/py/main.py): 18 apply functions converted, callers updated, kit classes added (TransportKit, ArchiveKit, SyncKit, DevKit, LocalKit, RemoteKit), validation message parity fixed. 85/85 tests pass.
- **Go** (compose/go/main.go): 36 apply functions converted to pointer receivers, kit types added (TransportKit, ArchiveKit, SyncKit interface, DevKit, LocalKit, RemoteKit), deepCloneKit helper added. All tests pass.
- **Rust** (compose/rs/lib.rs): All apply functions converted to &mut self pattern, kit types added (TransportKit, ArchiveKit, SyncKit trait, DevKit, LocalKit, RemoteKit). 79/79 tests pass.
- **C#/.NET** (compose/net/Compose/Compose.cs): All apply functions converted to void return, kit classes added (TransportKit, ArchiveKit, ISyncKit interface, DevKit, LocalKit, RemoteKit). 88/88 tests pass (net8.0 + net48).

All synchronized kits (Dev, Local, Remote) share the same API via interface/trait. All CRUDs use exclusively diffs. Static kits (Transport, Archive) support import/export.
